title: Gaffney blocked Lockheed-to-Bigelow UFO material transfer

tellings.quote: fact, journalist George Knapp even testified to Congress saying that Gaffne was personally responsible for blocking the transfer of UFO materials from Loheed Martin to Bigalow Aerospace in 2008.

tellings.difference: Told by Knapp himself as a bare naming of Gaffney, with no date or details of the transfer.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Knapp naming the CIA's Glenn Gaffney before Congress as the man who blocked the Lockheed-to-Bigelow material transfer.

as_told.title: Glenn Gaffney of the CIA named as a UAP gatekeeper

plain: This story is about Glenn Gaffney, a senior CIA official. The podcast host Jesse Michels says that George Knapp, a journalist who has long covered UFOs, told Congress under oath that Gaffney personally blocked a transfer of UFO material in 2008. As Michels tells it, the material was to move from Lockheed Martin, a large defence company, to Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company. If true, it would mean the CIA was guarding physical UFO material held by a private firm. In a later episode, a guest named Dylan Borland simply names "Glenn Gaffney, CIA" when talking about the congressional hearing. He gives no date and no details of the transfer.
